changes.before: One exception applies to the inventory entry: if a player is missing during a shift when the desk lead is absent, the volunteer must write “pending lead review” in the ledger and notify the building manager before locking up
changes.after: If desk lead is absent, enter “pending lead review” in ledger and notify building manager before locking up
changes.reason: The rewrite makes the exception appear to apply whenever the lead is absent, rather than only when a player is missing during that shift.

changes.before: the manager is covering only until the lead returns, and should not be asked to authorise disposal or replacement
changes.after: manager cannot authorise disposal or replacement
changes.reason: Changes an instruction not to ask the manager into a claim that the manager lacks authority, and omits that the manager is covering only until the lead returns.
